chunks: 5157 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from more than one person, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
“Whoever assists against a believer with even half a word will come on the Day of Judgment with this written between his eyes: ‘Despairing of the mercy of Allah.’”

key_terms.آيِسٌ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ: despairing of the mercy of Allah; a sign of terrible divine estrangement
key_terms.بِشَطْرِ كَلِمَةٍ: with half a word; a figure for even the smallest degree of assistance
key_terms.مُؤْمِنٍ: a believer; here, a person whose sanctity and rights must not be violated
key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when deeds are exposed and recompensed

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about helping harm a believer even with a few words?
ai.summary: This hadith warns with extreme severity against aiding harm or oppression against a mu'min, even in the slightest verbal way. It portrays such complicity as a grave moral offense whose consequence appears publicly on the Day of Judgment as a sign of estrangement from Allah’s mercy.
